Shop.title: Shop
Shop.lede: The flavour cakes and sweets we make in the shop. Tap any item to see the details and order on WhatsApp.

CategoryPage.statusNote: Each item shows its status. We update it by hand during the day, so message us on <phone>{number}</phone> to be sure.
CategoryPage.askMessage: Hello La Porta, I’d like to ask about {category}.

OurWork.title: Our work
OurWork.lede: Cakes we have made for our customers’ occasions. Pick a design and tap “I want one like this”; we’ll prepare a WhatsApp message with its name.
OurWork.ctaTitle: Didn’t find what you had in mind?
OurWork.ctaBody: Tell us about the cake you want, and we’ll prepare a WhatsApp message with all the details.

Design.orderBody: Fill in what you know, and we’ll prepare a WhatsApp message with the design’s name. We confirm the price, size and date with you in the chat.

CustomOrder.title: Design your cake
CustomOrder.lede: Fill in what you know. When you’re done, we prepare a WhatsApp message with a summary; you send it, and we take it from there in the chat.
CustomOrder.paymentNote: There is no payment on the site. We confirm the price and date with you in the chat before we start.
CustomOrder.designUnavailable: The design you chose is no longer in our gallery, so the message leaves it out.
